Hi Sahil,

I saw your opening for the Graphic & UI/UX Designer role at SKO Systems and noticed your focus on both product interfaces and brand communication within the Cruise Application ecosystem.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I built reusable design templates and visual systems across more than 100 digital and print creatives that cut turnaround time for internal teams. Previously at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated findings into cleaner user flows.

You can see my B2B UX case study in Bounceless, which demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists, along with my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Pune. Would you be open to a quick look at the Bounceless case study?

Ananya
